title: 品牌故事：日常背後的生意
premise: 每一集講一個品牌、一件日用品，或一個大家天天用卻沒想過的標準：它怎麼來的、生意怎麼運作、付出過什麼代價，最後留給觀眾一個帶得走的觀察。全部是查核過的非虛構故事，只有旁白，畫面是卡通插畫。
note: 企劃清單在 docs/videos/story-plans/brand-stories-100；設計在 docs/videos/STORY.md。

look.style: flat 2D cartoon illustration for an explainer video, clean bold outlines, warm muted colour palette with teal and orange accents, simple geometric shapes, friendly rounded figures with simple faces, soft paper texture, consistent character design, one clear focal point, empty space in the bottom fifth of the frame
